'''Smuggler High Command''' was the codename [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] gave to the leadership of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who led the fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]]. They included Solo, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Mako Spince]], [[Roa]], [[Ana Blue|Sinewy Ana Blue]], and [[Rik Duel/Legends|Rik Duel]].
